name: morph
title: Morph
description: A card that grows into a dialog and folds back into the card (FLIP): position and size move on one spring, the content never stretches and the corners stay round. Closing mid flight turns around from the current speed. Focus stays inside, Escape, the backdrop and Close close it, focus returns to the card.
author: ARLing s. r. o. (https://arling.sk)
docs:
Morph from ARLing Motion (MIT).
React: import { Morph } from "@/components/ui/motion-morph".
The logic is in lib/arling-motion-morph.js (typed by the .d.ts next to it) and works without React: createMorph on your own markup.
Styles were added to your global CSS under @layer components (Tailwind v4).
With Tailwind v3 or no Tailwind, add https://arling.sk/motion/components/morph/morph.css to your styles instead.
Live demo and docs: https://arling.sk/motion/#morph
